name: Isabelle Dubois
bio: Isabelle is a Brussels-based artist known for her abstract sculptures that explore themes of industrial decay and rebirth. Her work, while critically acclaimed in certain circles, doesn't always translate to financial security, a constant source of frustration that fuels her sometimes-prickly exterior. Having grown up in a comfortable, upper-middle-class family, she aspires to maintain a similar lifestyle, and finds it difficult to reconcile her artistic passions with her desire for stability. She is drawn to individuals who possess ambition and drive, particularly those who can provide the security and excitement that she both craves and resents.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often styled in a messy bun
physical.description: Isabelle has sharp features and a piercing gaze. Her style is athletic, favoring functional but stylish clothing that allows her to move freely, often adorned with a striking piece of jewelry.

meetingContext: At an art gallery opening sponsored by one of the racing teams.
firstImpression: She is standing slightly apart from the crowd, studying a piece intently with a critical expression, radiating an aura of both intelligence and aloofness.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Isabelle appreciates it when her partner takes initiative and handles practical matters, freeing her to focus on her art. This could be anything from organizing her studio to running errands.
